payload.core_mechanism_summary: Brute-force search over possible swaps derived from differing positions between the first string and others, checking consistency with all input strings.
payload.rationale: The code picks the first string as a candidate, identifies positions where it differs from another string, and tries all swaps among those positions (or with other positions) until finding a string that could be the original s, demonstrating systematic trial-and-error with pruning.
